The substring approach in #2046 can produce false positives (e.g. `application/json-patch+json` would incorrectly satisfy the check). PR #1996's broader implementation is also more reusable if additional media-type checks are needed later.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 is a strict superset of #2214: it applies the same regex normalization but also extracts it into a `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper (avoiding duplication between the two call sites) and fixes a dependent bug in `shouldAttemptFallback` — the root-path guard changes from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` because after normalization a root path becomes an empty string, not `'/'`. Without that second fix (present in #2215, absent in #2214), the fallback loop would never short-circuit at root, causing redundant discovery requests.
